summary: Full E2E verification of Binary Fund Global after Socket.IO + msgpack migration. Backend (remote VPS at api.binaryfundglobal.com) verified via pytest (13/13 passed) covering health, socket.io polling handshake, auth (register/login/me/duplicate), market instruments+candles, wallet, trade place+settle+errors. Socket.IO live tick stream verified via python-socketio client with msgpack decode — received 9 binary ticks in 10s for subscribed EURUSD_OTC + depth/change snapshots. Symbol switch (subscribe event) confirmed to route ticks to newly-subscribed symbol. Frontend E2E via Playwright against the preview URL — login, /demo-trade renders live candlestick chart, Socket.IO connects over wss with binary frames, live prices update, symbol switch works, demo trade placed with $1, balance deducted, `trade_closed` event fires after 60s expiry → balance updated to won +$0.88 with toast, BrandLogo served from localStorage as data URL.

minor.issue: Provided admin password 'Iamhear@#12' returns 401 Invalid email or password. VPS reseeds admin password on each restart from /opt/bfg-backend/.env. Not blocking — testing done via freshly registered user.

integration_issues.issue: VPS backend CORS_ORIGINS whitelist rejects http://localhost:3000 (returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' on OPTIONS preflight). Local frontend on port 3000 cannot call the remote API directly. Testing had to use the preview URL https://fund-tracker-315.preview.emergentagent.com which IS whitelisted. Impact: if the user opens the app on http://localhost:3000 in a browser, all /api requests will fail. This may be intentional (production origins only) but worth confirming. Preview domain works fine.

action_items: OPTIONAL: update /app/memory/test_credentials.md whenever admin password on VPS changes (VPS reseeds from /opt/bfg-backend/.env ADMIN_PASSWORD on restart).

OPTIONAL: confirm whether http://localhost:3000 should be allowed in VPS CORS_ORIGINS (it currently isn't). If yes, add it on the VPS. Preview URL fund-tracker-315.preview.emergentagent.com already works.
critical_code_review_comments: DemoTrade.jsx line 47: token read once at module render time from localStorage into a top-level const; if user logs out & back in in same session, `authH` and Socket.IO auth={token} may still reference stale token because the effect only runs once ([] deps).
DemoTrade.jsx line 71: Socket.IO path is hardcoded '/api/socket.io/'. This is fine but not env-configurable if the ingress path changes.
BrandLogo.jsx: `decoding="sync"` and lowercase `fetchpriority` attribute cause React 18 dev warnings on some setups; consider `fetchPriority` (camelCase) to avoid noise. Not blocking.

Login.jsx uses withCredentials:true which forces credentialed CORS — combined with restrictive CORS_ORIGINS on VPS, this is why localhost:3000 is blocked. Working as designed if preview URL is the only sanctioned origin.
